The '''''Endurance''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] and the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Shoan Kilian/Legends|Shoan Kilian]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It later crashed on [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]] following crippling [[Sabotage of the Endurance/Legends|sabotage]] perpetrated by the young [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].

==History==
[[File:EnduranceEngineRoom-DT.png|thumb|left|230px|Boba Fett infiltrates the ''Endurance''{{'s}} reactor core]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], a young [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], posing as a cadet in the [[Clone Youth Brigade/Legends|Clone Youth Brigade]] nicknamed "Lucky", sneaked aboard the ''Endurance'' with a plan to plant a bomb in [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu's]] quarters, but due to the request of Windu's presence elsewhere on the ship, his bomb resulted only in the death of a [[Unidentified clone trooper (Endurance)/Legends|clone trooper]], not Windu. His plan scuttled, Fett then proceeded to detonate the vessel's [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]] in order to disable the ship and possibly kill Windu in the resulting crash. The explosion of the core tore the engines of the ship to fragments along with much adjoining superstructure, causing an evacuation of the doomed vessel. However, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Shoan Kilian/Legends|Shoan Kilian]], refusing a direct order from the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to evacuate, elected to stay aboard, along with many of his command staff (including [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ponds/Legends|Ponds]]), and go down with his ship. Kilian, Ponds, and another clone were later captured by Fett and the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]], [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], and [[Castas/Legends|Castas]].

[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and Mace Windu later searched the ''Endurance'' at its final resting place for survivors. On the bridge, they found a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] helmet, which contained a bomb planted by Fett. The bomb detonated, and the remains of the ''Endurance'' began to fall apart, trapping Skywalker and Windu. Fett, Sing, and Castas made their way to the ship to recover Windu's body, or to capture him if he was still alive.

Skywalker sent [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] to call the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] for help. However, the droid spotted the four bounty hunters approaching the bridge, and attempted to hold them back by dropping obstacles in their path. The bounty hunters eventually gave up, deciding instead to simply destroy the remainder of the ship using [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']].

[[File:EnduranceWreckage-R2CH.png|thumb|right|220px|The wreckage of ''Endurance'' on Vanqor's surface.]]
R2-D2, unable to send a clear transmission to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], flew [[Mace Windu's Jedi fighter/Legends|Windu's Jedi fighter]] into space for a better signal. However, his communications device was destroyed by the ''Slave I'', which pursued R2 and the starfighter. R2, however, managed to jump into hyperspace and reach Coruscant, where he informed [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] of Skywalker and Windu's situation. R2, Tano, and Koon returned to Vanqor with several clone troopers, and rescued Skywalker and Windu, leaving with them as the ''Endurance''{{'s}} Bridge fell apart.

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Endurance'' first appeared in [[Death Trap]], the twentieth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.
